content.name: LinkButton
content.normativeText: LinkButton href · variant primary|secondary|quiet 一句话：长得像按钮的链接，用于导航到另一页；同一对表，没有 loading 与 disabled。 须提供 ： href ；外链加 external-link 图标与 rel。 不用 ：触发请求或提交（用 Button）；正文里的链接（用 Text 的 link 样式）。

readerSummary.en: Provide href; external links include external-link and rel. This navigates and has no loading/disabled API; requests and submissions use Button.
readerSummary.zh-CN: 提供 href；外链带 external-link 与 rel。用于导航，不提供 loading/disabled；请求和提交用 Button。
readerSummary.ja: href を指定し、外部リンクには external-link と rel を付けます。移動用で loading/disabled はなく、送信には Button を使います。
readerSummary.ko: href를 제공하고 외부 링크에 external-link·rel을 붙입니다. 탐색용이며 loading/disabled가 없고 요청·제출은 Button을 씁니다.
readerSummary.fr: Fournir href ; ajouter external-link et rel aux liens externes. Navigation sans loading/disabled ; requêtes et soumissions utilisent Button.

typeDefinitions.name: LinkButtonProps

layout.constraint: Navigation text and optional icon determine width with token insets. Long labels ellipsize at the parent limit; do not fill a grid track.

example.snippet:
case "LinkButton": return state === "variants" ? (["primary", "secondary", "quiet"] as const).map(variant => <LinkButton key={variant} href={`#${id}-result`} variant={variant}>{c.invoice}</LinkButton>)
        : <LinkButton href={state === "external" ? "https://example.com/" : `#${id}-result`} rel={state === "external" ? "noreferrer" : undefined} data-tcrn-preview-state={state === "focus" ? "focus" : undefined}>{c.invoice}{state === "external" && <Icon name="external-link" />}</LinkButton>;
example.snippetKind: producer scenario excerpt; helpers and imports are in the source module
